title: 第一卷 第1章 斩妖除魔系统正在苏醒第一卷 第2章 嫂子别这样
lines: “芸娘，今晚你去偏房。”
“只要跟那傻子睡一觉，明天镇妖司不管来谁，镇妖令的事情都是咱们说了算。”
秦烈刚醒，就听见了这么两句话。
什么芸娘？什么偏房？
还有镇妖司又是个什么东西？
“你别觉得我心狠。”
“那傻子本来就是个没人管的，咱们收留他，已经是积德了。”
“他爹死在镇妖司，留下一个补缺名额，他那么傻，进去了也是送死，还不如留在家里，咱们也能照看一下。”
秦烈还在懵逼的时候，隔壁又传来了声音。
听起来像个男人，嗓门倒是挺粗，但就是中气不足，说两句话就要停下来喘一口，估计身体不太行。
屋里沉默了一会儿。
随后，一个女人的声音轻轻开口。
“当家的，他再傻，也是秦大哥的儿子，当年秦大哥救过你，咱不能做这种事。”
“我知道！我当然知道！”
“可我现在下半身已经动不了了，整日只能坐在轮椅上，家里没了收入来源，两个孩子还这么小，难道要让我眼睁睁的看他们饿死吗？”
女人没有应声。
“我又不是让你去害他性命，只是跟他睡一觉。”
“睡完了之后，对外就说他给咱拉帮套，那他就是咱家的人了。”
“自己家人处理自己家的家事，别人也说不着什么。”
“回头让你弟弟顶那傻子的缺，先在镇妖司干几年，等虎子大了之后，再让虎子接班。”
“这样子，咱们家也算有铁饭碗了，虎子的日子以后也不会太难过。”
声音到这里就没有了。
秦烈听到这，也是确定了一件事情。
隔壁那两个人说的那个傻子，大概就是他自己。
他想坐起来，脑子里立刻涌上来一股钝痛。
接着就是一大堆陌生的记忆在脑海里炸开。
大夏王朝。
黑山镇。
女帝登基，日月当空，仙武共存。
天下妖魔横出，藏匿人间，以凡人血肉为食。
女帝龙威震怒，设立镇妖司，猎妖除恶，只杀不渡。
这具身体也叫秦烈，十八岁。
他爹秦山河也是镇妖司的猎妖人，只不过三年前死在了一次任务里，留下了一个补缺名额。
按照规矩，猎妖人如果因功殉职，子嗣就可以顶上这个缺，进镇妖司当差。
哪怕只是最低等的见习猎妖人，也有不少月俸，供一家四五口人吃喝是绰绰有余的。
问题是，原身是个傻子。
content_en:
"Yun Niang, you go to the side room tonight."
"As long as you sleep with that fool, no matter who comes from the Demon Suppression Department tomorrow, we will have the final say on the Demon Suppression Order."
As soon as Qin Lie woke up, he heard these two sentences.
What Yunniang? What kind of side house?
And what is the Demon Suppression Division?
"Don't think I'm cruel."
"That fool is someone who has no one to care about. We are already doing good deeds by taking him in."
"His father died in the Demon Suppression Department, leaving a vacancy to be filled. He is so stupid. He will die if he goes in. He might as well stay at home and we can take care of him."
While Qin Lie was still confused, another voice came from the next door.
He sounds like a man, his voice is quite rough, but he is short of breath. He has to stop and take a breath after saying two sentences. He is probably not in good health.
There was silence in the room for a while.
Then, a woman's voice spoke softly.
"The head of the family, no matter how stupid he is, is still Brother Qin's son. Brother Qin saved you back then. We can't do this kind of thing."
"I know! Of course I know!"
"But now I can no longer move my lower body. I can only sit in a wheelchair all day. My family has no source of income. My two children are still so young. Do I have to watch them starve to death?"
The woman didn't answer.
"I'm not asking you to kill him, just sleep with him."
"After sleeping, tell the outside world that he helped us, and then he becomes a member of our family."
"My own family handles their own household affairs, and others can't say anything."
"Let your brother take over that idiot's job later. He will work in the Demon Suppression Department for a few years first, and then let Huzi take over after Huzi grows up."
"In this way, our family can be considered to have an iron rice bowl, and Huzi's life will not be too difficult in the future."
The sound stops here.
When Qin Lie heard this, he was certain of one thing.
The fool the two people next door were talking about was probably himself.
He wanted to sit up, but a dull pain immediately surged through his head.
Then a bunch of unfamiliar memories exploded in my mind.
Daxia Dynasty.
Black Mountain Town.
The empress ascended the throne, the sun and moon were in the sky, and immortals and martial arts coexisted.
Demons and demons appear all over the world, hiding in the world and feeding on the flesh and blood of mortals.
The empress Long Wei was furious and set up the Demon Suppression Division to hunt demons and eliminate evil, but only to kill them.
This body is also called Qin Lie, eighteen years old.
His father, Qin Shanhe, was also a demon hunter in the Demon Suppression Department, but he died in a mission three years ago, leaving a vacancy.
According to the rules, if a demon hunter dies in the line of duty, his heir can fill the gap and work as a sergeant in the Demon Suppression Department.
Even the lowest trainee demon hunter has a lot of monthly salary, which is more than enough to feed and drink a family of four or five people.
The problem is, the original person is a fool.
